phases.objective: Implement one canonical async-only facade over the verified SQL runtime composition that prepares durable plan-item and run parents before routing Journal and Reconciliation evidence exclusively through the parent-aware child writer.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Durable Tenant Repository Facade Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: An unmounted canonical facade validates the current operation and immutable plan, registers plan-item parents, transitions lease_acquired to executing when required, consumes the exact plan by the exact run, creates the run parent, and proves the resulting state through async readback before any child evidence append.
steps: Require an unmounted canonical verified SQL runtime composition.
Read the current durable aggregate asynchronously and validate exact operation, version, state, target, plan, hash, status, and run bindings.
Reject any binding or version mismatch before the first mutation.
Register every canonical plan-item parent with contiguous ordinals.
Transition lease_acquired to executing through the internal Control Plane facet when required.
Consume the exact immutable plan by the exact run.
Create or exactly replay the run parent only after plan-item completeness and plan consumption.
Read back executing operation state and exact plan consumption.
Route Journal and Reconciliation appends exclusively through the child-evidence facet.
Keep the route, worker, provider, migration, and Production boundaries disabled.
assertions: Factory construction performs no database-backed call.
The facade is async-only and is not compatible with the legacy synchronous Synthetic Executor contract.
Raw composition, transitionOperation, consumePlan, and legacy recordReconciliation methods are not publicly exposed.
Preparation ordering is read, plan-item registration, optional transition, plan consumption, run-parent creation, and final readback.
Executing same-run replay is supported after a fresh read without repeating the state transition.
Journal and Reconciliation writes have one parent-aware public path.
No route, server, worker, migration, live database, Hostinger, provider, main, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Connect the facade to a separately governed parent-aware async execution engine, durable authority and enablement stores, and Tenant-safe projection after mount authorization.
blockers: The current Synthetic Executor is synchronous and memory-adapter-owned and cannot consume this async facade.
Durable authority and one-shot enablement stores are not implemented.
Dedicated worker, fixed dispatch, restart reconciliation, and Tenant-safe projection are not complete.
No route or worker mount authorization exists.

phases.objective: Prove partial preparation recovery, stale version read-before-retry, run replay, child replay, and restart-safe reconciliation through the future async execution engine.
This unmounted facade does not dispatch a Provider or run a live Tenant canary.
Production database access, runtime mounting, Provider dispatch, and Production promotion remain separately authorized and blocked.
